newsitem.title: USA: Value Health has not set meeting date.
newsitem.headline: Value Health has not set meeting date.

text.p: Value Health Inc said on Wednesday announced that it has set April 30, 1997 as the record date for its upcoming special meeting of shareholders, but a date for the meeting to vote on a merger with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp has not yet been set.
Columbia/HCA and Value Health revised the terms of the deal earlier this month to value it at $1.2 billion, or $20.50 a share in cash, to reflect a drop in Columbia/HCA's stock.
When the deal was announced in January, Columbia/HCA was going to issue 0.58 shares of its stock for each Value Health share for a total original value of $1.3 billion.
Shares of Columbia/HCA, the owner and operator of 340 hospitals and healthcare facilities, had fallen after reports about a federal investigation of its billing practices.
Value Health provides specialty benefit programs to large corporations, insurance carriers, managed care organizations, and federal, state and local governments.
A Value Health spokeswoman said the company will give the meeting date in the proxy statement that it will mail to shareholders.
